Use the rule that students get shared rooms (5 in first three years, 2 in Dal, 3 in Tawi) and single rooms in Jhelum based on CGPA as a memory trigger. Create a simple sentence: “Five, two, three—CGPA decides the room!” This turns a procedural detail into a memorable phrase, making it easier to recall room-sharing rules across years and student types.

The students who are not able to get a single room in the Jhelum hostel are allotted the Dal hostels, where the students reside in the ratio of 2 students per room.
